context: The detection report lists two consent-platform matches (Didomi and one other), two heuristic modals, and scroll_locked: true with a CSS scroll_fix. Sessions are disposable, so hiding (quick mode) is preferred over clicking through consent. Judge cleanup.sh.

checklist.name: hides_all_overlays
checklist.description: cleanup.sh hides all four overlays in the report (#didomi-host/#didomi-notice, #cmp-container-id/.main--cmp, #didomi-popup, #dialog-menu), e.g. with `web page overlays --session <s> --dismiss --mode quick`, or by injecting the report's `hide` rules.

checklist.name: scroll_fix
checklist.description: Because scroll_locked is true, the scroll lock is fixed: `--dismiss` does it in both modes, or cleanup.sh applies the report's scroll_fix (html,body overflow:auto).

checklist.name: single_injection
checklist.description: The overlays are handled in one command (one `web page overlays --dismiss` call, or one injected <style> element), not one command per overlay.

checklist.name: no_consent_clicks
checklist.description: Uses quick mode (hide-only) and does not click through the consent platforms' dismiss steps, since the session is thrown away and clicking is slower.

checklist.name: valid_eval_expression
checklist.description: Any `web browser eval` or `playwright-cli eval` argument is a single JavaScript expression (no top-level statements separated by semicolons, no bare `return`).

checklist.name: residual_check
checklist.description: Includes a check for remaining viewport-covering elements: inspecting `residual` in the `--dismiss` output (empty means clean), an eval listing position:fixed high z-index elements intersecting the viewport, or a viewport screenshot to inspect.

checklist.name: page_not_broken
checklist.description: Does not hide or remove <html> or <body>.
